column1: # OOD-PerceptionBench -- PUBLISHED seed-42 observations for the smoke-split routes
# *** THIS IS NOT A GOLDEN FILE. ***
# These are the values the reference agent produced on the authors' build during the
# published sweep. Nobody has measured how far they move on different hardware, so there
# is no defensible tolerance attached to them and check_acceptance.py does NOT read this
# file. It exists for two narrower purposes:
#   1. it tells whoever generates real goldens what to expect, so a wildly different
#      number is noticed at generation time rather than after publication;
#   2. observed_agent_type documents, from the published run, that the actor which spawned
#      on each of these routes really did carry the type_id the route XML asks for.
# make_golden.py reports the delta against these numbers as INFO and never gates on it.
